en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an idyllic rural landscape. There is a river or large stream winding through open fields, with bundles of harvested crops in the foreground and a smattering of small buildings and farmhouses in the distance. Low hills or mountains provide a backdrop. The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, a green 5 öre stamp featuring King Gustav V of Sweden, a postmark from Fränsta, and addressing lines.
